newsitem.title: USA: Buckhead America says to buy Lodgekeeper.
newsitem.headline: Buckhead America says to buy Lodgekeeper.

text.p: Buckhead America Corp, a hospitality services company, said Thursday it agreed to acquire Lodgekeeper Group Inc a closely held concern that manages 24 hotels in Ohio, Indiana and Michigan. Terms weren't disclosed.

Lodgekeeper operates 18 hotels under long-term leases, holds management contracts on five Country Hearth Inn hotels and owns one independent hotel. The company also owns 10 percent interest in four of the Country Hearth Inns and a 17 percent interest and the management contract on a Country Hearth Inn under construction in Cincinnati.
Buckhead America purchased franchising rights and trademarks of the Country Hearth Inn brand from Lodgekeeper in 1994 and is expanding the chain nationally.
